Jibhi Jalori Tirthan 4N/5D
Departure: Friday 9:00 PM from Akshardham Metro Station, Delhi, by Tempo Traveller. One dinner stop, not included.
Day 1 (Friday): Overnight drive from Delhi towards Aut.
Day 2 (Saturday): Continue from Aut to Jibhi. Check-in from 11 AM, then guided tour of Jibhi Waterfall, Mini Thailand and nearby villages. Breakfast and dinner included.
Day 3 (Sunday): Drive up to Jalori Pass, short hike to Serolsar Lake. Return for bonfire and dinner.
Day 4 (Monday): Breakfast at 8 AM and checkout. Hike to Chhoie Waterfall in Tirthan Valley, then start the overnight journey back to Delhi.
Day 5 (Tuesday): Arrive back in Delhi in the morning, about 7-8 AM.
